report.root_cause: Minecarts were mass-summoned via RCON (log shows "[Rcon: Summoned new Minecart]"), reaching about 230 across the world and driving MSPT to 170+ and TPS to about 12. I could not identify who or what issued the summons. The log source was only "Rcon". There was also high MSPT at startup (131 ticks behind) with only 24 entities, and I did not find the cause of that.
report.actions: Checked status and logs. Used the console to locate entities: 10 end crystals in a ring, 4 striders, and the named minecarts Cart 1, 2 and 3. Declared the incident. Saw minecarts rising from 3 to over 200. Killed all minecarts not named Cart 1, 2 or 3 in three passes (238, 57 and 11 entities). The summoning stopped. Generated a timings report. Verified entities back to 24 and MSPT falling to about 27 with 1m TPS recovering to 17.5.
report.residual_risk: The RCON summon source was not identified, so it could resume. TPS had not fully recovered when I submitted (1m TPS about 17.5), and the cause of the high MSPT at startup is unexplained. My diagnostic teleport-in-place command touched the 10 end crystals, but they did not move. Any real player-owned minecarts lacking the names Cart 1, 2 or 3 would have been killed. I did not check for such carts beforehand.
